description: New York-based AI-native Know-Your-Business (KYB) platform using agentic AI to verify business identity for banks and fintechs — compressing verification from 10 days to under 10 minutes. Founded 2023; backed by Gradient Ventures (Google AI), Picus Capital, Canary, Gilgamesh before Kaszek.
current_status: Six months post-launch: deployed with leading local and global banks and fintechs. Kaszek's first move outside LATAM residents — a strategic bet on US-based KYB infrastructure that can serve LATAM fintech growth.

founder.name: Niva founding team
founder.background: New York-based, emerged from stealth 2024. Limited public information on backgrounds — Kaszek's first non-LATAM-resident bet was made in part on founder profile, but the detail is not yet public.
founder.problem_fit: PROBABLE — Gradient Ventures (Google AI fund) backing pre-Kaszek suggests a credible technical bench. But without public founder-experience detail, this cannot be fully underwritten.
founder.execution_evidence: Shipped product in 6 months post-launch; deployed with leading banks and fintechs; compressed verification from 10 days to <10 minutes.
founder.red_flags: Insufficient public data on founder history vs incumbent KYB players (Middesk, Persona, Alloy) who ship faster under competitive pressure.

stage_context.vs_base: Niva beats seed base rate across thriving (+8pp) and breakout (+4pp) from AI-native speed advantage (10 days → 10 mins). Dead tier cut in half (-23pp) from the already-shipping distribution with top banks. But Middesk/Persona feature-copy risk caps realistic upside — most-likely outcome stays at surviving.

verdict: Niva survives IF (a) agentic-AI accuracy stays above 97% on business verification (Middesk benchmark is ~94% manual-review-required), (b) at least 2 top-20 US banks or card networks sign pilots within 12 months, (c) incumbent KYB vendors (Middesk, Persona, Alloy, Trulioo) do not ship comparable agentic-AI features before Niva lands reference customers. Most fragile: (c) — Middesk already has the distribution; shipping an agentic layer is a quarter's work.
top_risk: Middesk and Persona are funded ($25M+ Series B each) and can replicate the speed-up by embedding LLMs into existing workflows; Niva has a feature, not a moat
top_opportunity: Global KYB is genuinely under-solved for cross-border businesses — the opaque corporate registries in LATAM, SEA, and Africa are where agentic AI has the largest marginal utility over structured-data incumbents
